title: Chapter 30 First
content:
Chapter 30 First

"The procession has always been arranged with the old at the front and the young at the back. How dare you change the ranks at will? You are so brave!"

Bin Baijiang was so aggressive that his fingers almost touched the tip of Heifu's nose.

Faced with his accusation, Heifu did not panic, but immediately confessed to the county right lieutenant: "The villain did not know about this, but he just heard Chen Baijiang say that this does not violate the laws and regulations, so he made the decision privately... "

Chen Baijiang had just received the fruits that Hei Fu had sent to him. At this moment, it was difficult to clear up the matter, so he had to bite the bullet and said: "Your Majesty, Hei Fu did ask me about this matter..."

Seeing that the two men "confessed their guilt", General Bin Bai was even more proud. He felt that this way, Guishi's first place in the competition would be ruined, and he quickly said: "This black man has confessed his guilt, and I hope you will be punished by your lieutenant!"

His innocent look made Zuo Weiyunman look away in anger.

Right Lieutenant Du Xian just stroked his beard, looked around between Heifu, Chen Baijiang, Bin Baijiang, and Left Lieutenant Yunman, and then said slowly: "Heifu, do you know why I When the Qin State arranges its troops, should the old soldiers be in the front and the new soldiers in the back?"

Heifu quickly lowered his head: "This is my first time serving. I don't know much about it. I don't know what the meaning is. I hope your right lieutenant can give me some advice." In fact, he had already asked clearly. It is customary for the elder to be in front and the younger to be behind, but it is not a legal requirement. , since the law doesn’t say it can’t be done, then it can be done, right?

But Heifu really didn't have time to think carefully about the reason for this routine.

"Whenever two armies confront each other, the front row is the first to face the enemy. If the new soldiers are in the front, they will easily be frightened by the murderous spirit on the battlefield and retreat backwards, overwhelming the entire formation. The battle will be lost..." Youwei said earnestly.

"It is not the case if the elite soldiers are at the front. They are familiar with the formation, understand the military regulations, have experienced battle formations, and can hold their own when encountering the enemy. Even if all of them died in the bitter battle, the new soldiers behind them survived the battle, and If you can become a veteran, you will become a rock in the army in the next war. In this way, the veteran will be endless, and the art of battle formation will last for hundreds of years and be passed down from generation to generation. Only then will our Qin country be victorious in every battle. Master!"

Right Lieutenant Du Xian was indeed trained in Guanzhong and had experienced countless battles, both large and small. From being a pawn during the reign of the late king, he marched into the Eastern Zhou Dynasty under the orders of Marquis Wenxin, to Wang Jian's victory over Handan and the destruction of Zhao two years ago. After what he said slowly, Heifu immediately understood the meaning of the Qin army's old soldiers in the front and the new soldiers in the back, and he couldn't help but sweat profusely.

The tiger and wolf divisions of the Qin Army were not a one-time blessing, but were passed down from generation to generation.

From this point of view, it is indeed reckless for me to adjust the order at will in order to organize the queue during the inspection. The ancients were not stupid at all, and they will not dare to be arrogant in the future.

"Heifu knows his mistake, damn it!"

"Whether you deserve to die or not is not up to you, nor is it up to anyone else, it depends on what the law says."

Right Lieutenant Du Xian turned his head to the side: "Wei Shi!"

"only!"

Wei Shi on the side immediately agreed, and Wei Shi was a subordinate of the county captain.

"It is said in military law that if the commander adjusts the formation at will, what is the crime?"

The officer hesitated for a while and then said: "I dare to tell you that the old soldiers should be in the front and the new soldiers should be in the back. Although it is the practice of the Qin army, it is not written in the military laws and regulations."

"Indeed? Have you forgotten?"

Wei Shi knelt down on one knee and said: "I will never forget. If there is any omission, I am willing to follow the Qin law. If you dare to forget the so-called name of the master's decree, everyone will be punished according to the name of the forgotten decree!"

This is an ingenious provision in the "Laws of Qin": If a judge or military judge who masters the laws and orders dares to forget the provisions of the laws and orders, you will punish yourself with the law you forgot!

Darling, if we forget about the death penalty and the sentence of treason, wouldn’t it be the end?

Therefore, every judge and military judge's daily job is to recite the laws and orders very well, and they never dare to make mistakes, because this is a matter of life and livelihood.

Du Xian, the right lieutenant of the county, nodded and said: "So, there is indeed no punishment for this in the military law. Heifu just committed the crime without knowing it, and it was definitely not intentional. Since there is no corresponding punishment in the military law, then this lieutenant also There is no reason to punish him. Our Qin State has never had a precedent of punishing someone without teaching him! Hei Fu, just remember this lesson in the future."

"You must remember this!" Heifu knew that this was the step given by the right lieutenant, so he quickly took it.

"In this case, Guishi still ranks first in today's military exercise!"

As soon as the right lieutenant said this, Heifu breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed that he had made the right bet.

"You Lieutenant! How can you be so lenient!" General Bin Bai never expected that the final result would be like this. He wanted to argue, but was stopped by You Lieutenant.

Du Xian looked solemn and scolded General Bin Bai: "General Bin Bai, do you think I don't know why you are obstructing me? As a general, how can I behave like a general and compete with an ordinary soldier because of personal enmity?"

"In April last year, the county governor said in the "Yu Shu" that the so-called evil officials are those who like to gossip, have no sense of shame, have no sense of justice, and are offensive, and like to compete when doing things. When they compete, They pretend to stare and hold their wrists to show that they are brave; they are arrogant and arrogant to show that they are capable, and their boss still thinks they have talent.”

When he mentioned "boss", the right lieutenant glanced at the left lieutenant Yun Man, then pointed at General Bin Bai and said: "In my opinion, you are the so-called evil official. This kind of person must be punished. "

General Bin Bai was stunned. He never expected that this would be the result.

"Didn't you promise before that if Guishi wins the championship, you will go around the school grounds with three hundred jumps and three hundred jumps? Well, if you do what you say, I will grant you a double punishment! Just go around the school grounds. On this school ground, give me ten laps from Yuequyun! To set an example for others!"

After finishing speaking, Du Xian looked at Zuo Wei Yunman and said with a smile: "Zuo Wei, do you think it is appropriate for me to punish you like this?"

He spoke kindly but did not tolerate criticism.

He seems to be consulting, but he is arbitrary.

In the eyes of the right lieutenant, General Bin Bai's reckless interruption was like an affront to the authority of his chief officer by the Zuo lieutenant's group. How could he not kill the chicken to scare the monkey?

Although Zuo Wei felt sorry for his son-in-law, they were indeed unreasonable in this matter. For the sake of the future, he could only break his teeth and swallow blood. He forced a smile and said: "What You Wei said is that he should be allowed to grow up." Remember it!"

Bin Baijiang was dumbfounded. Now, even his backer, Zuo Lieutenant, had given in. He had no choice but to clench his fists and restrain himself.

He raised his head, gave the gloating Chen Baijiang a hard look, and the innocent-looking Hei Fu, and staggered down to the stage. He was about to take off his armor and jump, but he heard the order from the right lieutenant:

"Dance in armor!"

General Bin Bai swayed and looked at Zuo Wei, but Yun Man turned his head away with a sullen face, only giving him a back view.

"promise!"

The generals had no choice but to reluctantly agree, so in front of hundreds of county soldiers and hundreds of watchmen, they wore heavy armor and circled the huge school grounds, starting to perform the leaping leap, also known as squatting frog. Jump……

Clatter, clatter, general Bin Bai's armor made a sound with every movement he made. The county soldiers and watchmen looked at this scene dumbfounded. They did not dare to speak at first, but the right lieutenant ordered them to count carefully. Then, they started to count the laps for the guest...

"One lap...two laps...three laps."

The generals jumped slower and slower, silently muttering in their hearts that they must make the black husband repay the humiliation they suffered today. However, the watchmen became more energetic and shouted louder and louder.

"Four laps, five laps, six laps!"

Every time he crouched, his armor made his limbs ache. Every time he jumped, he thought it was the last time...

But the military order was like a mountain and the oath was in his ears. He had to keep moving forward. Even if he had to climb, he had to complete the ten laps!

When Bin Baijiang's limbs were so weak from dancing that he was about to faint, Heifu had already been announced by the county right lieutenant that in this ten-day competition, Guishi led by him would win the "best", that is, first place.

He held the rewarded jug of rice wine in his hand and put ten pieces of dried meat on his arm. He walked slowly down the platform, just in time to see General Binbai jump to the seventh lap. He was exhausted, panting like an old dog. He fell to the ground, barely raised his head, and looked at him angrily.

"Heifu, Zhuzi!" His eyes seemed to burst and bleed.

"Come on, General Bin Bai."

Heifu gave the general a thumbs up and showed an encouraging smile, which made the general almost want to vomit blood.

On that day, when General Bin Bai asked the county soldiers to pin Hei Fu down at his feet, insulting and abusing him, did he ever expect this day?

It’s not that I won’t report it, the time has not yet come.

Hei Fu's humiliation was avenged today with the help of the county right lieutenant! At the same time, Heifu couldn't help but admire the right lieutenant of the county. His methods were really sharp. He not only warned his opponents by knocking on the mountain and shocked the tiger, but also maintained his authority. He also bought the heart of this "strong man", killing two birds with one stone, and killing two birds with one stone.

Ignoring General Bin Bai who was constantly cursing, Heifu returned to his team amid cheers from Guishi. As promised, he distributed the dried meat to everyone in Shizhong, and raised the rice wine in the earthen jar with both hands, as if it was a trophy he had won...

"Brother Heifu!"

Ji Ying was so excited that he burst into tears. Only he knew how difficult these days were for Hei Fu and how much he had to sacrifice.

"We are number one!" Dongmen Bao cheered, immersed in victory, and Xiao Tao also giggled beside him.

"Win the best!" The tallest male was ecstatic and raised his cousin piggy up high.

Ping, Ke and Bu looked at each other and smiled. They knew that in the next few days, they would be able to eat meat and drink wine.

Even the usually calm Uncle Chao was stroking his goatee and laughing. His hands could not help but tremble slightly. This was probably the most glorious moment he had experienced in more than a dozen times of service.

After a long time, Heifu finally calmed down the excited people. He squeezed out of the crowd and walked towards Jiashi.

In the emotions of fear or admiration, the guards automatically separated a path, and Heifu walked straight over and grabbed Yuan Bai who was about to run away!

"The walls and cypress trees are very long."

Heifu looked at the rich man with a bitter face, took out the deed from his arms, waved it in front of his eyes, and smiled kindly: "Don't run away in a hurry, don't forget, you still owe me It’s four thousand dollars!”
